Name: Joan Leland
Description: Joan Leland is best known for meeting and allowing Harley Quinzel to interview the Joker. Joan was in the DC Animated Univese cartoons she was in four episodes in Batman: The Animated Series "Harley's Holiday" and in The New Batman Adventures "Mad Love", "Double Talk", and "Chemistry".
